title: Sousou no Frieren
description:
After the party of heroes defeated the Demon King, they restored peace to the land and returned to lives of solitude. Generations pass, and the elven mage Frieren comes face to face with humanity’s mortality. She takes on a new apprentice and promises to fulfill old friends’ dying wishes. Can an elven mind make peace with the nature of life and death? Frieren embarks on her quest to find out.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title: Haru
description:
Music video directed by Kohta Morie for the song Sunny by Yorushika.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the second opening theme of the anime Sousou no Frieren.

title: Sousou no Frieren: Marumaru no Mahou
description:
Frieren loves collecting peculiar spells, and her ever-growing arsenal of magic contains the perfect spells for many occasions. Whether it be by stealthily removing alcohol from Heiter's drinks or by remedying her own sleep issues, Frieren is sure to brighten her companions' days with her magic.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Yuusha
description:
Music video directed by Keisuke Hiroe for the song Yuusha by YOASOBI. The song is based on a special novel by Jirou Kiso, supervised by Kanehito Yamada.

Note: The song featured in this music video also serves as the first opening theme of the anime Sousou no Frieren. There exist two versions of this video, the first being a Japanese version uploaded on September 29, 2023, and an English version of the song titled "The Brave" by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 24, 2023.
